My name is from Dowa, and maize is our life here. This season I will try to buy at least one bag of 23:21:0+4S for basal and one bag of urea for top dressing if the AIP coupon comes through, because without fertilizer the soil here gives very little. I keep a few chickens and my husband's goats, so I will carry what manure I can to the field before the rains. I cannot afford irrigation or much hired labor, but during weeding I will call two or three neighbors for ganyu to help me finish in time.
